title: Last Call at the Velvet Room
setting: The Velvet Room speakeasy, Chicago, after closing
blurb: The band packed up. The lights went low. And somebody settled Lucky Mickey's tab for good.
victim: "Lucky" Mickey Doyle, owner of the Velvet Room, was struck on the head in the cellar vault tonight at about 1:30 am and found dead at 1:45.

intro: Rain hammered Chicago the night Lucky Mickey Doyle's luck ran out.
At one in the morning the Velvet Room closed its doors. By a quarter to two, Mickey lay dead on the floor of his own cellar vault, the iron door hanging open, his ledger gone.
The front door was locked. The alley door was bolted, or should have been. Five people were still inside the Velvet Room.
narration.detectiveEnters: And then you walked in out of the rain, detective. Nobody here paid you, and nobody here owns you. Find out who closed Mickey's account.

rooms.name: Cellar Vault
rooms.description: Brick walls, crates of contraband, and an iron vault door left wide open.

rooms.name: The Stage
rooms.description: A velvet curtain, a battered piano, and the singer's dressing room behind it.

rooms.name: The Bar
rooms.description: Mahogany, mirrors, and a hundred bottles that don't officially exist.

rooms.name: Back Alley
rooms.description: Rain, garbage cans, the cellar stairs, and a police callbox at the alley mouth.

suspects.name: Sgt. Patrick O'Rourke
suspects.story: Sergeant Patrick O'Rourke. Twenty years on the force, a laugh like a barrel, and a pension he talks about like a sweetheart. He keeps this block quiet. Everybody says so.
suspects.voice: jovial, back-slapping, Irish-Chicago, talks down to civilians

suspects.name: Dolly Mae
suspects.story: Dolly Mae. The voice that packs the Velvet Room every night. Mickey found her singing on a street corner, and he never let her forget who made her a star.

suspects.name: Frankie Malone
suspects.story: Frankie Malone. Eight years behind Mickey's bar. He hears every secret in Chicago and swears he forgets them by morning.

suspects.name: Ace Delaney
suspects.story: Ace Delaney. Fingers like lightning on the keys, and a nose for a side hustle. He plays till closing and slips out the back after.

suspects.name: Vivian Doyle
suspects.story: Vivian Doyle. Mickey's big sister and the brains of the Velvet Room. She signs half the checks and does all the math.
